headline: Monolithic Power Systems (NASDAQ:MPWR) Soars After Q2 Earnings Beat
summary: Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) smashed Q2 estimates with a 47.6% revenue surge and $6.50 EPS, driving a 7.9% after-hours stock rally on strong AI and automotive demand.

headline: Could Monolithic Power Systems' (MPWR) Lofty Earnings Projections Reframe Its AI Investment Narrative?
summary: Earlier this week, analysts projected that Monolithic Power Systems would report quarterly earnings of US$5.88 per share on US$903.97 million in revenue, implying very large year-over-year growth in both metrics and a slight downward revision to EPS estimates over the past month. The combination of strong expected earnings expansion and references to prior outperformance has sharpened attention on how resilient Monolithic Power Systems’ profit and growth profile may be across its core end...
